hints.text: Rewrite $7$ as $7.0$ so both numbers have a tenths place.
You cannot take $4$ tenths from $0$ tenths, so borrow: $7.0$ becomes $6$ wholes and $10$ tenths.
$10 - 4 = 6$ tenths, and $6$ wholes are left, giving $6.6$ — choose A.

explanation: Write $7$ as $7.0$ so the tenths line up.
There are $0$ tenths on top, so regroup one whole into $10$ tenths: $7.0$ becomes $6$ and $10$ tenths.
$10 - 4 = 6$ tenths, and the whole-number part is $6$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Why the others are wrong
steps: $3$ comes from ignoring the decimal and doing $7 - 4$.
$7.4$ comes from adding instead of subtracting.
